items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: He said, “Now Butch, you and Milt have worked with Count Basie before.” ... ctx.x: Milt Hinton, what a team, Urbie Green, Bucky Pizzarelli, Joe Temperley, Frank Wess, Joe Wilder, and Dick Hyman charts. And actually this one I would have on my desert island list.
